intro: From near the entrance to Jacobson Park, the byway runs southeast across I-75 and follows Grimes Mill Road to McCalls Mill Road, 6.8 miles in all. Grimes Mill Road carries on a little past that end to Boone's Creek and the Grimes House and Mill Complex, with its house, mill, springhouse, and cemetery, and the foundations of a flax house and a distillery.
The mill rises two and a half stories, its quarried-stone walls three and a half feet thick around a hand-hewn wooden frame. It was in use until 1927.

moments.title: Grimes springhouse
moments.text: Across the road from the mill, a quarried-stone springhouse with a stone doorway and an earthen mound faces straight out onto Grimes Mill Road.

moments.title: Grimes Mill
moments.text: The Iroquois Hunt, named for the first American-bred horse to win the Epsom Derby, made the old mill its permanent headquarters in 1928.
